summary: Progression sketch for the complete Monk faction's native one-time powers and permission unlocks; the actual live six-skill tree in src/main/resources remains unchanged for the next client test.

backend_rules.native: Vampirism 1.10 one-off abilities, staged hand-harvest/breath unlocks and Monk-only Tyz purchase licenses; never grant Tyz levels directly.
backend_rules.tyz: One canonical global MXP/Tyz XP+SP wallet, no separate Monk numeric stat tree; independent magic and attribute ranks stay in primary Tyz.
backend_rules.rank_guides: earliest_rank_design is a tuning guide, NOT enforced by the current Vampirism skill tree. Future server-side skill purchase gates must enforce any chosen minima or world milestones.
backend_rules.nonlive: Only six existing nodes are implemented and purchasable (including root). Future nodes here are not registered, not rendered, cannot consume SP and have no effects.
backend_rules.points: One native point per faction rank is currently the pilot; future branch allocation and any bonus-point talents require economy review, so no promise of all nodes on one character.
backend_rules.origin_source_policy: Do not duplicate the 24 shared Tyz traits, 43 aliased affixes, 40 bounded Tyz affix ranks, or generate all 203 preliminary endpoints here. No creative flight and no Unbound affix.
backend_rules.gate_policy: Only First Sunset is presently enforced. Ender Dragon and Chaos Guardian gates are design requirements pending robust server-side attribution; no easy FTB Quest claim or purchased item substitute.

tracks.name: Martial Discipline
tracks.goal: Legal unarmed combat, counters, spirit projectiles, boss interaction and selected affix conversions.

tracks.name: Body & Mobility
tracks.goal: Safe traversal, footwork, water movement, teleportation and post-Dragon momentum glide.

tracks.name: Contemplation & Resilience
tracks.goal: Meditation, animal empathy, breathing and non-absolute environmental protection.

tracks.name: Empty-Hand Harvest
tracks.goal: Real finite harvest tiers and distinctive tool-free gathering while repeatable mining speed stays in Tyz.

tracks.name: Arcane Mastery & Licenses
tracks.goal: Only faction-specific one-time/progression permission, not a second generic mana or spell-stat wallet.

nodes.name: First Sunset Initiate
nodes.effect_contract: Existing sunset rite: permanent Monk identity and native tree root.

nodes.name: Open Palm
nodes.effect_contract: Live: +1 empty-hand attack damage while Monk discipline allows.
nodes.notes: Pilot numeric effect; future scalable attack power remains in primary Tyz.

nodes.name: Unarmored Poise
nodes.effect_contract: Live: +2 armor while observing no-conventional-armor discipline.
nodes.notes: Pilot one-time bonus is distinct from future Tyz natural armor ranks; audit overlap.

nodes.name: Stone Fist
nodes.effect_contract: Live: first finite hand harvest tier (+4 speed); cannot bypass advanced ore requirements.

nodes.name: Fleet Footwork
nodes.effect_contract: Live: +5% movement speed under discipline.
nodes.notes: Early fixed unlock only; further speed purchases belong to Tyz.

nodes.name: Step Assist
nodes.effect_contract: Live: +0.5 step height; no automatic rank-one step bonus.

nodes.name: Guarding Palm
nodes.effect_contract: Defend/parry or counter with empty hands; define incoming damage and cooldown rules.

nodes.name: Catch Arrows
nodes.effect_contract: Intercept eligible arrow projectiles and optionally collect; no unlimited ranged invulnerability.

nodes.name: Spirit Projectile
nodes.effect_contract: Legal innate ranged attack without conventional bow; interacts with boss shield/crystal rules.

nodes.name: Withering Stare
nodes.effect_contract: Sustained line-of-sight gaze inflicts controlled withering on valid targets.

nodes.name: Looting Palm License
nodes.effect_contract: Unlocks Monk-specific Tyz Looting Palm purchase when a verified loot hook exists.

nodes.name: Galvanizing
nodes.effect_contract: Shield affix adapted to unarmed defense/guarding; event adapter required.

nodes.name: Retreating
nodes.effect_contract: Shield affix adapted to unarmed defensive retreat; no conventional shield required.

nodes.name: Omniscient
nodes.effect_contract: Verified source-equivalent unarmed effect rather than free generic magic power.

nodes.name: Deathbound Spirit
nodes.effect_contract: Bounded one-time spirit-projectile affix effect; source mechanics must be verified.

nodes.name: Steadfast
nodes.effect_contract: Innate body-footing analog of boots affix, with explicit event handling.

nodes.name: Surefooted
nodes.effect_contract: Innate anti-slip/traversal analog; no invisible boots equipment slot.

nodes.name: Unhurried
nodes.effect_contract: Innate movement-oriented boots affix adaptation; source cooldowns apply.

nodes.name: Water Walking
nodes.effect_contract: Walk over water surfaces without permanent potion or special boots.

nodes.name: Blink
nodes.effect_contract: Short safe line-of-sight teleport with collision check and cooldown.

nodes.name: Momentum Gliding
nodes.effect_contract: Innate controlled elytra-style gliding with modest thrust; NEVER Creative Flight.
nodes.notes: Post-Ender-Dragon pre-Chaos target. No vanilla/Draconic creative-flight override.

nodes.name: Breath Meditation I
nodes.effect_contract: First of two stages: slower oxygen depletion while submerged.

nodes.name: Breath Meditation II
nodes.effect_contract: Second and final stage: sustained underwater breathing; no extra duplicative air ranks.

nodes.name: Animal Friendship
nodes.effect_contract: Gentle animal interaction/assisted taming, without coercive global mob pacification.

nodes.name: Creeper Kiss
nodes.effect_contract: Original Monk's unusual creeper interaction, safe and limited by explicit cooldown.

nodes.name: Purifying Meditation
nodes.effect_contract: Cleanses selected negative effects; not unconditional potion immunity.

nodes.name: Hunger Discipline License
nodes.effect_contract: Permission to buy source-backed Tyz hunger-efficiency ranks, preserving food-discovery motivation.

nodes.name: Fire Resilience License
nodes.effect_contract: Permission to buy bounded Tyz flame-damage mitigation ranks.

nodes.name: Lava Survival
nodes.effect_contract: Brief source-backed protection in lava, not total hazard immunity.

nodes.name: Explosion Resilience License
nodes.effect_contract: Permission for bounded Tyz explosion-resilience ranks without duplicate shield benefits.

nodes.name: Iron Fist
nodes.effect_contract: Second finite empty-hand harvest tier: iron-quality equivalent; preserve effective-tool drops.

nodes.name: Diamond Fist
nodes.effect_contract: Third finite harvest tier: diamond-quality equivalent for validated blocks.

nodes.name: Netherite Fist
nodes.effect_contract: Higher finite tier only where block/tag rules prove it differs from diamond.

nodes.name: Exotic Fist
nodes.effect_contract: Optional last tier only for real pack-specific harvest requirements.
nodes.notes: Omit entirely if no distinct effective harvest tier.

nodes.name: Glass Touch
nodes.effect_contract: Break glass barehanded while receiving the correct harvest result, not generic Silk Touch.

nodes.name: Delicate Hands
nodes.effect_contract: Source-verified empty-hand silk-like harvesting with eligibility and tag restrictions.

nodes.name: Gentle Shearing
nodes.effect_contract: Tool-free shearing behaviors for appropriate entities/blocks.

nodes.name: Fortunate Hands License
nodes.effect_contract: Permission for bounded Tyz fortune ranks and a legitimate server loot adapter.

nodes.name: Sandforming
nodes.effect_contract: Tool-free analog of the pinned Apotheosis breaker affix, context-limited.

nodes.name: Stoneforming
nodes.effect_contract: Tool-free analog of the pinned Apotheosis breaker affix, context-limited.

nodes.name: Supermassive
nodes.effect_contract: Advanced area-break effect; respect claims, block protection and server limits.

nodes.name: Gardening
nodes.effect_contract: Innate controlled foliage/harvest behavior adapted from source affix.

nodes.name: Leafforming
nodes.effect_contract: Tool-free leaves behavior; no unlimited area work without cost.

nodes.name: Monastic Mastery Learning License
nodes.effect_contract: Native permission for a Monk-only Tyz mastery-gain improvement; no XP from this node alone.

nodes.name: Focused Advancement License
nodes.effect_contract: Native permission for separately balanced Tyz skill-point progression; cannot mint points unconditionally.
nodes.notes: Potential economy exploit; defer actual effect until canonical MXP wallet and skill-point caps are proven.

nodes.name: Telepathic
nodes.effect_contract: Adapt exact source affix effect to innate Monk technique, not a generic mind-reading system.

nodes.name: Magical Spirit
nodes.effect_contract: Source-backed magical projectile effect on legal spirit bolts.
nodes.notes: Cross-track prerequisite from the martial branch.

nodes.name: Acidic Spirit
nodes.effect_contract: Pinned ranged affix conversion to spirit projectile; status effects and costs require adapter.

nodes.name: Empty-Hand Paragon
nodes.effect_contract: Reserved high-end unarmed capstone, to be designed for gear parity without a weapon.
nodes.notes: New proposal; not sourced from original ability list; no numbers/effects yet.

nodes.name: Stillness Paragon
nodes.effect_contract: Reserved capstone for defensive/contemplative play, balanced against endgame gem armor.

automatic_no_purchase.contract: A legal unarmed/spirit projectile or player-cast spell must interact with Draconic Guardian crystal and shield mechanics using normal boss checks; no paid license or bypass.
All legal player-cast magic sources use the single shared MXP dispatcher and attribution, not extra native skill purchases.

deferred_non_native: All 24 primary shared Tyz skill families (including movement speed, attack power, Potency, Reservoir, Thrift, etc.)
The 40 bounded special Apotheosis affix effects owned by Tyz
The 43 affix-to-attribute aliases with no second purchase
Breath stages only as finite native unlocks; numeric oxygen buffs, if any, must not stack twice
Any skill involving raw Creative Flight or Apotheosis Unbound
open_questions: Test whether the first native Monk skill point and tree purchase work with pinned Vampirism 1.10 before activating new nodes.
Balance 20 native skill points versus multiple branches and decide whether some nodes should be rewards or mutually exclusive.
Prove event adapters and protected-block/claim behavior before enabling affix powers.
Validate actual higher-tier block tags, tools and drop rules before adding more harvest tiers.
Define precise boss defeat credit, party credit and external gate persistence.
Decide whether new rank-20 capstone proposals are acceptable before implementing their effects.
